programs.description: Veera, a young bride-to-be, is abducted by a local gangster, Mahabir, and his men a day prior to her wedding. Far from being terrified of her abductor, Veera discovers a new meaning to her life.
A sighted pianist, feigning blindness, faces myriad complications after inadvertently witnessing an ex-film star's murder.
Aman, a Pakistani man, falls for Asha, an Indian woman, and wishes to marry her. So, he attempts to impress her family, but chaos erupts when his nationality is revealed.
Prem, a school dropout, hesitantly marries an educated but overweight girl, Sandhya. However, the two come closer when they take part in a race, which involves Prem carrying Sandhya on his back.
After her son's unexpected death, a sorrowful mother heads to Kolkata, only to find herself grappling with the complexities of his undisclosed past.
Meera, an attractive single mother of Indian origin living in Australia, faces the wrath of her family after she falls in love with an Australian man.
The life of Nambi Narayanan is full of struggles and accomplishments as an aerospace engineer. However, he faces his biggest challenge while working at ISRO when the world accuses him of treason.
In 1971, Ghazi, a submarine from Pakistan, tries to destroy the port at Vizag but, S21, an Indian submarine, poses as an obstacle.
The lives of a wealthy man and a poor man intersect one fateful night. This unforeseen event ends up changing things drastically for them and their families.
Saloni, a young woman, discovers that she has been impregnated by two men, Akhil and Gurbir. Chaos ensues as the two men compete for Saloni's heart.
Despite heavy opposition from their parents, Aditya and Suhani run away and get married. However, cracks soon begin to develop in their fairy-tale romance.
A charming diamond thief and his unwitting sidekick embark on a rollercoaster of romance, espionage, and explosive transcontinental battles, proving that love can indeed conquer all.

Despite facing a loss in the 1952 Summer Olympics, Coach Rahim builds a formidable football team and strives to bring glory to India.
Nakul, a 25-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend in jeopardy.
Vinod, a railway engineer, launches the Super Express, a dream project that is India's fastest passenger train. However, it goes out of control on its maiden journey due to a bomb planted by a rival.
Jass, a lawyer's son, is in love with Meet, but the proposal is rejected by his father. However, he strives to win his lover's hand and devises a plan.

After completion of her examinations, Mumbai-based Rhea Dialdas, who lives with her parents; younger sister, Minty; and paternal grandmother, looks forward to spending more time with hunky Luv Nanda, the son of Mukesh - rumored to be a smuggler.
A struggling actor tries to prove his mettle but fails repeatedly. His life changes when he meets Tina who encourages him to participate in a nationwide talent hunt.
Sriram, a self-centred man, lies to his girlfriend, Dia, for his selfish gain. However, later, Sriram realises his mistake and has to fulfil a condition laid down by Dia to win her back.
When a young journalist questions the immoral behaviour of a revered religious leader in his article, the latter files a case against him in court.
Manu, an NRI doctor, comes to India in search of a bride and falls in love with Tanu. Poles apart from her suitor, Tanu, a fun-loving girl, rather enlists his help in eloping with her lover.
After John Day and Maria lose their daughter in an accidental forest fire, it affects the mental health of Maria. Later, a courier person enters their home and abducts her.
